name: RUNNERS
source:
Hero is a social studies teacher at a girls' school. He founded runners club and is going to raise champions in there. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一所女子学校的社会学科教师。他创立了跑步社，打算在那里培养冠军。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
